name: NextIX - Route Servers
notes:
NextIX – Virtual Connectivity with a Vision for the Future

At NextIX, we are currently focusing entirely on a purely virtual infrastructure. 

Our immediate priority is providing highly flexible, location-independent digital connections. 

However, our roadmap is clear: we actively aim to expand our network and shift our focus toward establishing physical locations moving forward.

As a free, non-profit project, our existence depends entirely on the support of our sponsors:

No Membership Fees: Joining the NextIX Exchange is, and will always remain, completely free of charge because its only possible to join with our Transit Project which is free of Charge.

External Costs: Our Members reserve the right to charge setup fees or recurring fees for VLANs, Cross-Connects, or Physical Links.
